cohort: The study included healthy full term infants (n = 13 per dietary regimen group) who were assigned to different dietary regimens or served as a breastfeeding reference group.
finding: The Lactobacillus paracasei CBA L74-fermented formula was safe and well tolerated, increased secretory IgA, and reduced microbiota diversity, favoring the maturation of the immune system, microbiota, and metabolome, similar to breastmilk.
mod_finding: Metabolome analysis showed distinctions in subjects based on their mode of delivery.
